source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
A model’s profile gives:

- **M**: move speed; with M ‘-’ it can only be set up, never moved.
- **T**: toughness.
- **Sv**: armour save, as a dice result.
- **InSv**: invulnerable save, as a dice result, if it has one.
- **W**: wounds; at 0 or fewer it is destroyed, and it has full wounds while its remaining wounds equal its W.
- **Ld**: leadership, as a dice result.
- **OC**: objective control; with OC ‘-’ it can’t control objectives.

All modifiers stack. Modify a value in this order:

1. Change or replace it with any set value; a characteristic set to ‘0’, ‘-’ or an asterisk this way takes no further modifiers.
2. Multiply.
3. Add.
4. Divide.
5. Subtract.
6. Round fractions up.

Characteristics of ‘-’, an asterisk or ‘N/A’ are never modified, and changing a model’s WS or BS changes it on all its weapons. Unless stated otherwise, after all modifiers:

- M and Range are at least 1".
- T, A, S and D are at least 1.
- Sv and InSv are no better than 2+.
- Ld is between 5+ and 8+.
- OC is at least 0.
- WS and BS are between 2+ and 6+.
- AP is 0 at worst.

A +1 to a characteristic improves it and a -1 worsens it. Improving Sv, Ld, WS or BS lowers the number before the ‘+’; worsening raises it. Improving AP subtracts from it; worsening or reducing it adds, but never past 0. Other characteristics rise when improved and fall when worsened.

For dice rolls and other values:

- Modify after any re-rolls; an ‘unmodified’ roll is the result after re-rolls, before modifiers.
- Modifiers can push a result past the die’s top face; a result under 1 becomes 1.
- The net Hit or Wound roll modifier is capped at -1 and +1.
- A Charge roll can’t exceed 12.
- **Detection range** and **Lone Operative** stay between 9" and 30".
- A Stratagem’s CP can rise by at most 1 and can’t go below 0.

A rule to ignore modifiers covers the unit’s rolls, profile and weapon characteristics unless stated otherwise, and you can ignore only some modifiers, such as just the penalties.

Random characteristics:

- **M**: roll once for the whole unit when it is selected to move.
- **A**: roll per weapon when generating its attacks, then group identical attacks.
- **D**: roll each time an attack inflicts damage, once the opposing player has picked the model it is allocated to.
- That D roll is a **damage roll**.
- A value after an operator in D, as in D6+1, is part of D, not a modifier.
- Others: roll per model or weapon each time one is needed.

A unit that heals regains lost wounds 1 at a time: each goes to a wounded model or, once every model has its starting wounds, revives a destroyed non-CHARACTER model with 1 wound. No model exceeds its starting wounds. A rule that heals one model affects only that model, and leftover wounds revive nothing.
